message.content:
**UNO – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)**  

| Section | What Happens |
|---------|--------------|
| **Goal** | Be the first player to score at least 500 points over one or more rounds. Points come from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. |

---

### 1️⃣ Setup  
1. Shuffle the UNO deck (108 cards).  
2. Deal each player 7 cards face‑down; keep them secret.  
3. Place the remaining deck facedown as the *draw pile*. Flip its top card into an open *discard pile* next to it.

> ⚠️ If the flipped card is a special action card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild), treat it like any other starting card—no extra effect on the first turn unless you choose otherwise.

---

### 2️⃣ Turn Order & Direction  
- Players sit around the table and play clockwise.  
- A “Reverse” card flips direction instantly (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise).

---

### 3️⃣ Playing Cards  
On your turn you may:

| Card Type | How It Works |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Number (0–9)** | Must match either color or numeric value of the discard’s top card. |
| **Color Match** | Same color regardless of number. |
| **Wild** | Any color can follow; you declare the new active color immediately after playing it. |
| **Draw Two (+2)** | Opponent draws two cards then misses their turn. You may stack another +2 if they have one. |
| **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. |
| **Reverse** | Changes play order. In a 2‑player game, acts like Skip. |
| **Wild Draw Four (+4)** | Like Wild but forces opponent to draw four cards. Can only be played legally if you truly cannot match the current color with any regular card. *(See “Challenge” below.)* |

If you can't play any legal card, you must draw one from the draw pile:
- If that drawn card is playable, you may use it right away.
- Otherwise, end your turn without drawing again until the next cycle.

---

### 4️⃣ Winning a Round  
When a player discards all seven cards, the round ends. That player scores points based on the values of the cards still held by others:

| Card Value | Score |
|------------|-------|
| Number cards | Face value (e.g., 5 → 5 pts) |
| Draw Two / Skip / Reverse | 20 pts each |
| Wild / Wild Draw Four | 50 pts each |

Add those points to the winner's total. Then start a fresh round (reshuffle discarded cards back into a new draw pile, deal anew).

---

### 5️⃣ Scoring & Game End  
Play continues until someone reaches **at least 500 points**. At that point, the highest scorer wins overall. Some groups prefer lower thresholds (200, 300) or simply play a set number of rounds.

---

### 6️⃣ Optional/House Variants  
*(Feel free to tweak before you begin!)*  

| Variant | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Stacking** | Allow players to stack multiple +2s or +4s consecutively instead of just once per turn. |
| **No Challenge** | Disallow challenging Wild Draw Fours; anyone can play them freely. |
| **Speed Play** | Remove the rule requiring a player to draw if unable to play; instead, skip turns entirely. |
| **Custom Deck Size** | Use fewer cards for quicker games (remove some high-value specials). |
| **Team Mode** | Pair up; partners share hand visibility and combine scores. |

---

#### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet  
```
• Color matches OR same number → play normally.
• Wild → pick new color.
• +2 → next draws 2, skips turn (stackable).
• Skip → next player loses turn.
• Rev → reverse direction.
• +4 → wild + force 4 draws (challenge possible).
```

Enjoy the colorful chaos—and remember: strategy comes from knowing which cards to hold onto versus shedding early!
